mapper.sql:
SELECT id,
CASE WHEN author_type = 'USER' THEN author_id END user_id author_user_id id NULL AS ownerUserId,
status AS contentStatus, NULL AS currentRevisionId, NULL AS publicRevisionId content_status AS contentStatus, current_revision_id AS currentRevisionId, public_revision_id AS publicRevisionId
FROM WHERE id = #{targetId}

id, reporter_user_id AS userId, target_type AS targetType, target_id AS targetId, evidence_revision_id AS revisionId, reason_code AS reason, description, status, resolution AS decisionReason, created_at AS createdAt, resolved_at AS decidedAt
mapper.select: SELECT FROM s_content_report WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM s_content_appeal a JOIN s_content_moderation_log l ON l.id = a.moderation_log_id WHERE a.id = #{id}

SELECT id, content_type AS targetType, content_id AS targetId, revision_id AS revisionId, action, reason, created_at AS createdAt FROM s_content_moderation_log WHERE content_type = #{targetType} AND content_id = #{targetId} ORDER BY id DESC

SELECT id AS revisionId, revision_no AS revisionNo, body, moderation_status AS moderationStatus, created_at AS createdAt,
overall_score AS overallScore, court_score AS courtScore, environment_score AS environmentScore, service_score AS serviceScore, anonymous, (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(t.name ORDER BY rel.position SEPARATOR '、') FROM s_venue_review_tag_rel rel JOIN s_review_tag t ON t.id = rel.tag_id WHERE rel.revision_id = r.id) AS tags
NULL AS overallScore, NULL AS courtScore, NULL AS environmentScore, NULL AS serviceScore, NULL AS anonymous, NULL AS tags
, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM s_post_media m WHERE m.revision_id=r.id AND m.cleanup_status='PURGED') (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM s_venue_review_media m WHERE m.revision_id=r.id AND m.cleanup_status='PURGED') 0 AS purgedMediaCount FROM
s_post_revision r WHERE post_id s_venue_review_revision r WHERE review_id s_post_comment_revision r WHERE comment_id s_venue_review_reply_revision r WHERE reply_id = #{targetId} ORDER BY revision_no DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE s_content_report SET status=#{status}, resolution=#{resolution}, operator_admin_id=#{adminId}, resolved_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id=#{id} AND status='PENDING'
mapper.sql: a.id, a.appellant_user_id AS userId, l.content_type AS targetType, l.content_id AS targetId, a.moderation_log_id AS moderationLogId, l.revision_id AS revisionId, l.action, a.body AS description, a.status, a.decision_reason AS decisionReason, a.created_at AS createdAt, a.decided_at AS decidedAt
mapper.select: SELECT FROM s_content_appeal a JOIN s_content_moderation_log l ON l.id = a.moderation_log_id WHERE a.id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT MAX(id) FROM s_content_moderation_log WHERE content_type = #{targetType} AND content_id = #{targetId}

SELECT l.id, l.id AS moderationLogId, l.content_type AS targetType, l.content_id AS targetId, l.action, l.reason, l.created_at AS createdAt, a.status FROM s_content_moderation_log l LEFT JOIN s_content_appeal a ON a.moderation_log_id = l.id WHERE l.action IN ('REJECT','HIDE','DELETE','RESTRICT') AND ( (l.content_type = 'USER' AND l.content_id = #{userId}) OR (l.content_type = 'POST' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM s_post p WHERE p.id=l.content_id AND p.author_type='USER' AND p.author_id=#{userId})) OR (l.content_type = 'REVIEW' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM s_venue_review r WHERE r.id=l.content_id AND r.user_id=#{userId})) OR (l.content_type = 'COMMENT' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM s_post_comment c WHERE c.id=l.content_id AND c.author_user_id=#{userId}))) ORDER BY l.id DESC LIMIT 100
mapper.update: UPDATE s_content_appeal SET status=#{status}, decision_reason=#{reason}, operator_admin_id=#{adminId}, decided_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id=#{id} AND status='PENDING'
UPDATE s_user_content_restriction SET revoked_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id = #{restrictionId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND revoked_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM s_user_content_restriction WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND capability=#{capability} AND revoked_at IS NULL AND (expires_at IS NULL OR expires_at > UTC_TIMESTAMP(3)))

SELECT (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM s_content_report WHERE target_type = #{targetType} AND target_id = #{targetId} AND status = 'PENDING') OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM s_content_appeal a JOIN s_content_moderation_log l ON l.id = a.moderation_log_id WHERE l.content_type = #{targetType} AND l.content_id = #{targetId} AND a.status = 'PENDING'))
mapper.update: UPDATE SET deleted_at = NULL, purge_after = NULL, content_status = CASE WHEN public_revision_id IS NULL THEN 'PENDING' ELSE 'PUBLISHED' END, updated_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id = #{targetId}

UPDATE
s_post_revision s_venue_review_revision s_post_comment_revision s_venue_review_reply_revision
SET moderation_status = 'APPROVED' WHERE id = #{revisionId} AND moderation_status = 'REJECTED'
